compliance_statement: Runtime reconstruction operates strictly without querying online map databases, external cadastral registries, CityGML models, commercial building APIs, or runtime LiDAR point clouds.

permitted_inputs.description: Uploaded RGB GeoTIFF or high-resolution orthophoto
permitted_inputs.role: Optical texture, building instance boundary cues, and photometric evidence

permitted_inputs.description: Georeferencing metadata embedded in uploaded GeoTIFF (GDAL GeoTransform, ProjectionRef/WKT, GSD, optional RPC)
permitted_inputs.role: Scene coordinate system definition, geographic registration, and metric scale mapping
permitted_inputs.runtime_access: Extracted in-memory via GDAL dataset header

permitted_inputs.description: Permitted low-resolution reference DEM (SRTM GL1 30m / Copernicus GLO-30 / local bare-earth raster)
permitted_inputs.role: Coarse bare-earth DTM reference plane anchoring
permitted_inputs.runtime_access: Local SrtmExtractor service querying pre-cached SRTM tiles

permitted_inputs.role: Exclusive metric height authority (h_AGL) above ground level; scientific raster output
permitted_inputs.runtime_access: Local NdsmInferenceService worker via gRPC/shared memory

permitted_inputs.description: GAMUS semantic segmentation network (ground, building, road, vegetation, water)
permitted_inputs.role: Semantic class probabilities for building seed acceptance, road barrier isolation, and vegetation masking

permitted_inputs.description: Segment Anything Model 2.1 (SAM 2.1 Hiera Base+), gated by feature flag DEPTHWIZARD_SAM2
permitted_inputs.role: Boundary refinement of candidate building instances prompted by semantic and nDSM evidence (Phase 4)
permitted_inputs.runtime_access: Isolated Modal microservice over HTTPS with deterministic local fallback

permitted_inputs.description: KIBS two-stage Mask R-CNN roof-section and corner decomposition, gated by feature flag DEPTHWIZARD_KIBS
permitted_inputs.role: Roof-section polygonization and corner height-class topological hints (Phase 5)
permitted_inputs.runtime_access: Isolated Modal microservice over HTTPS with deterministic native fallback

strictly_prohibited_sources.rule: Zero queries to OpenStreetMap (OSM) Overpass API, Nominatim, or offline OSM planet dumps at runtime.
Zero queries to municipal, state, or national property boundary/cadastral polygon databases.
Zero ingestion of pre-existing LoD1/LoD2/LoD3 CityGML or CityJSON building repositories.
Zero queries to Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles, Mapbox Buildings, Cesium OSM Buildings, or Bing Maps 3D.
Zero dependency on airborne or terrestrial LiDAR point clouds during runtime reconstruction. Reference LiDAR is restricted exclusively to offline validation and ablation.

scientific_integrity_guarantees.height_authority: All reported metric building heights, elevations, and volumetric calculations are derived exclusively from the GAMUS-calibrated nDSM and ReferenceTerrain DTM.
scientific_integrity_guarantees.scientific_raster_immutability: DTM, DSM, and nDSM rasters are never modified, smoothed, flattened, or exaggerated by 3D rendering operations.
scientific_integrity_guarantees.presentation_boundary: Procedural facade window grids, tone mapping, soft shadows, ambient occlusion, and visual vertical exaggeration are explicitly categorized as presentation features and excluded from scientific measurements.

representative_fixtures.description: High building density with flat-topped structures of varying heights (15m to 45m), narrow alleys, rectilinear outlines, and flat terrain.
representative_fixtures.test_focus: Instance separation, party wall prevention, clean prism footprint regularization, flat roof elevation agreement.

representative_fixtures.description: Lower-height detached residences (6m to 12m) with pitched/gable/hip roof geometry, separated lots, street network, and yard vegetation.
representative_fixtures.test_focus: LoD2 roof fitting, pitch classification vs flat fallback, avoidance of over-segmentation.

representative_fixtures.description: Isolated large-footprint structures surrounded by parking surfaces, bare ground, and roads.
representative_fixtures.test_focus: High recall without false positives, accurate perimeter tracing without neighbor interference.

representative_fixtures.description: Buildings situated along sloped hillsides with 30m to 90m DTM elevation variation.
representative_fixtures.test_focus: Wall base sampling against sloped ground, metric vs flat_urban mode selection, pedestal prevention.

representative_fixtures.description: Dense tree canopy (>55% vegetation cover) with embedded or partially occluded structures.
representative_fixtures.test_focus: Conservative presentation selector retaining terrain/skirts, vegetation barrier enforcement, tree occlusion recovery.
